videos.description: No sooner had she arrived in Belrose than Loïs lost everything: her boyfriend and her flat. Along with his best mates, he's launched Campus Drivers, a student ride-hailing app. But Loïs's arrival, combined with Aaron's return to campus, soon threatens to shake up the calm.

Determined to stay, she finds support in Becca, Carrie, Hope, and Prudence, slowly rebuilding her confidence. But living with Lane raises new questions. Between the mysterious locked room and Aaron's return, the secrets surrounding Lane threaten the fragile balance they've built.
